```{r}
#| label: demographics-ancova-els
#| include: false

# Generate age-stratified demographic tables limited to ANCOVA complete cases for ELS outcomes
demographic_variables <- c(
  "demo_age", "sex", "Race", "Ethnicity", "weight_kg",
  "leit3_nv_iq", "cgis_soi_fct", "Molecular.Category"
)

demographic_labels <- list(
  "demo_age" = "Age (years)",
  "sex" = "Sex",
  "Race" = "Race",
  "Ethnicity" = "Ethnicity",
  "weight_kg" = "Weight (kg)",
  "leit3_nv_iq" = "IQ",
  "cgis_soi_fct" = "CGIS Severity of Illness",
  "Molecular.Category" = "Molecular Category"
)

els_var <- c("nar_ndw50_a", "con_ndw50_a")

demog_tbls_ancova_els <- summarize_demographics_ancova(
  dataset = data,
  outcome_vars = els_var,
  demo_vars = demographic_variables,
  demo_labels = demographic_labels,
  age_stratify = TRUE,
  demo_age_var = "demo_age"
)

demog_merged_ft <- demog_tbls_ancova_els$merged |>
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |>
  flextable::width(width = demog_tbl_width)
```

### Table 1a: All Subjects

Baseline characteristics of all subjects with complete ANCOVA data for ELS outcomes.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-demographic-ancova-els-all
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of the study cohort by treatment (subjects with complete ANCOVA data for ELS outcomes)."

demog_all_ft <- demog_tbls_ancova_els$all |>
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |>
  flextable::width(width = demog_tbl_width)

demog_all_ft
```

\
